fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of Gross Revenues, subject to a minimum of $125 per week (not monthly). NAP (National Advertising Program) contribution is currently $75 per week per store; can be increased but capped at 1% of weekly Gross Revenues; no increases in first year. BIZTRAX CRM Software: currently $1,200 per year. CAD Design Software Keys updates: currently $70 annually. Email Address/Mailbox: currently $7–$10 per month per account. Transfer fee: 50% of then-current Initial Franchise Fee, minimum $24,750. Renewal fee: 25% of then-current Initial Franchise Fee, minimum $12,375. Bank charges: currently $50 per occurrence. Management fee: currently $500 per day per person plus expenses. Additional training: currently $300 per person per day plus travel. Marketing materials: cost of production plus 20% markup. All fees collected via ACH and are nonrefundable.

Royalty | 5% of Gross Revenues subject to a minimum of $125 per week | Payable on each Monday via ACH for the week ending the immediately prior Saturday. | (See Note 1)
(NAP) National Advertising Program Contribution | Currently $75 per week- per store. Can be increased but any increased amount will not exceed 1% of weekly Gross Revenues provided that no increases will occur in the first year of the agreement. | Payable weekly on Monday via ACH for the previous week | (See Note 2)

Supplier Testing | Reimbursement of our costs of inspection and evaluation and costs for testing. | At time of testing and inspection. | This fee will be incurred only upon your request to use a supplier or product.

Insurance | Cost of Insurance / Cost of Review (up to $500) | Upon invoice | ...
Indemnification | Will vary under circumstances | As incurred | (See Note 4)
Bank Charges and Administrative Costs | Our then current fee (currently $50 per occurrence). | Upon invoice | ...
De-Identify | Our costs | As incurred | ...
BIZTRAX CRM Software | Then-current fee (currently $1,200 per year). | Annually | ...
CAD Design Software Keys updates | Then-current cost (currently $70 annually) | As incurred | ...

Management Fee | Our then-current fee (currently $500 per day per person plus expenses if we have to temporarily manage your store.) | At time of provision of such services. | ...
Additional Initial Training; Refresher courses; Supplemental Training; Conferences | Our then-current fee (currently $300 per person, per day) plus all reasonable travel, room, board and living expenses | As incurred | ...
Cooperative Marketing | As determined by the members | As determined by the members | ...
Marketing Materials | Cost of production plus a 20% markup | As incurred | ...
Email Address/Mailbox | Our then-current fee (currently $7-$10 per month, per account) | Annually | ...
